chunks: Have trust in the Mighty, the Merciful,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to have trust in the Mighty and the Merciful?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a divine reassurance to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) amidst the ridicule of the Quraysh, affirming that true reliance rests on the One who is both omnipotent and merciful. Shia scholarship emphasizes that this 'tawakkul' is not passive resignation but an active spiritual state rooted in recognizing Allah's absolute sovereignty (Al-Aziz) and His compassionate care (Al-Rahim) for the faithful. It underscores the theological principle that divine support is guaranteed for those who maintain steadfast trust in God's attributes during times of trial.
